headline: Swedish broadcaster TV4 has pushed a reality show's new season to 2027 after the finished edits were wiped from a production company's server.
score_reason: Cause is disputed (AI agent versus human error and a failed backup) and the Aftonbladet report dates from 14 Oct, so one point below the pool score.
importance_line: It delays a TV series for Swedish viewers and its production crew, and adds to the debate over giving AI agents server access, but TV4 says the cause was human error, not AI.
summary: Swedish newspaper Aftonbladet reported on Wednesday 14 Oct 2026, citing unnamed sources and as relayed by Gizmodo, that an AI agent given access to production company Mastiff's server deleted the finished edits of the second season of the Swedish version of MTV's The Challenge. Broadcaster TV4 confirmed the season, due on 22 Nov, is now delayed to 2027, but says its investigation found human error and a failed backup, not AI, and that the raw footage survives.
notes: Source chain: Aftonbladet (first reporter) via Gizmodo; Aftonbladet link not seen so url is the Gizmodo page where the text was read. Report dated 14 Oct, so freshness marked as before 15 Oct.
